curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Long dismissed as childhood imagination, four persistent ghosts suddenly reappear in a pragmatic adult's life with an urgent mission.
curatedMovie.description: After perishing in a 1959 bus crash, four guardian spirits are tied to a boy born that night. Decades later, the grown businessman must confront the invisible childhood companions who need his help to move on.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A warm, medium-paced fantasy comedy that balances lighthearted supernatural antics with genuine emotional sentiment.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Ron Underwood blends romantic comedy and supernatural fantasy into a warm, heartfelt story about lifelong bonds and second chances.
